tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rten thams cad kyi gnas gsum du// rten thams cad kyi gnas gsum du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ thub dbang thugs kar/ oṃ bhe hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ā ā hī hī/ shi ba shi ba/ shān+ti shān+ti/ sha ma sha ma sha ma pa ya ta thā ga ta a nu ga ta swa bhā wa a bhā wa sa murtā ya a pa ma ba la a bai ra la ba la a mṛ ta ba la a ti ba la haṃ ghuṃ ghuṃ/ dh+rau dh+rau/ bh+rau bh+rau/ bh+re du bh+re du hī hī bha ga wān bha wan+ta ka pu ra ta bhe ga ma hā shān+ti ka ra sā pa kilbi ṣa nā sha ka swāhā/ ye dharma he tu pra bha wa he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya wa tad/ te ṣañtsa yo ṇi ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇa: 'dod gsol ni/ rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba/ /ye shes rgya mtsho gser gyi lhun po 'dra/ /grags pa 'jig rten gsum na lham me ba/ /mgon po mchog gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma dam pa brgyud par bcas rnams dang / /rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad dang / /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems sogs/ /bde skyid bu 'khrid 'brel par bcas la dgongs/ /bde skyid bu 'khrid 'brel par bcas pa yis/ /tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /da lta'i bar du lus ngag yid gsum gyis/ /sdig pa mi dge'i las rnams ci bgyis pa/ /de dag thams cad mthol zhing bshag par bgyi/ /mtshams med lnga dang de dang nye ba lnga/ /mi dge bcu spyad so thar sdom pa dang / /byang chub sems bskyed gsang sngags dam tshig dang / /'gal bar gyur pa thams cad mthol lo bshags/ /khyad par du yang bla ma dam pa la/ /ma gus bsrung ba'i dam tshig las 'das pa/ /mi 'bral ba dang bza' ba'i dam tshig rnams/ /ma bsten bsnyen sgrub g.yel ba mthol lo bshags/ /dam tshig ma dag spyod yul gcig pa sogs/ /mtho ris thar pa'i gegs su gyur pa dang / /'khor ba ngan song rgyur gyur sdig pa sogs/ /nyes pa ltung ba'i tshogs rnams ci mchis pa/

/de dag thams cad bla ma yi dam dang / /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems kyi/ /spyan sngar mi 'chab mi sbed mthol lo bshags/ /dus gsum dge ba kun la rjes yi rangs/ /rgya chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /mgon skyabs bral ba'i sems can thams cad la/ /tshad med thugs rje'i spyan gyis rtag tu gzigs/ /rgya chen smon lam btab tshad 'grub par shog /bde skyid bu 'khrid 'brel bcas thams cad la/ /las dang glo bur rkyen las gyur pa yi/ /nad gdon 'byung po'i 'tshe ba la sogs pa/ /skye zhing skye bar 'byung bar ma gyur cig /gang du skyes kyang bde zhing skyid par shog /dam chos tshul bzhin spyod pa'i skyes bu dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes chen rnams/ /zhabs pad brtan zhing phrin las rgyas gyur cig /mchog gsum bslu med rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis/ /bde skyid bu 'khrid 'brel bcas thams cad kyang / /ngan song gsum dang sdig pa'i las spyod pa'i/ /rgyal por ma skyes mtho ris mi lus su/ /skyes ma thag tu dam chos tshul bzhin du/ /nyams su len zhing tshul khrims ldan par shog /'jig rten khams 'dir lo phyugs legs pa dang / /dus 'khrug la sogs yid mi bde ba'i las/ /yul phyogs kun tu 'byung bar ma gyur cig /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rims sdug bsngal sogs/ /lus can kun la 'tshe bar gyur pa yi/ /sdug bsngal mtha' dag myur du zhi gyur cig /bde skyid bu 'khrid 'brel bcas thams cad kyang / /tshe ring nad med bde zhing skyid par shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam thugs rje dang / /chos srung dam can rgya mtsho'i nus mthu dang / /rgyu 'bras bslu med rnams kyi bden stobs kyis/ /smon lam ji ltar btab pa 'grub gyur cig/ ༈ /'jam dbyangs kyi thugs kar/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bhe ma hā ma ṇi ru tsi ra/ ka lā pa bi tsit+t+ra muk+ta dā ma/ a laṃ kṛ ta sha rī ra sa pa ra satwa mo tsa ka ta thā ga ta ma ha dhar+m+ma ko ṣa dha ra dhar+m+ma lasta bi dza ya su ra ta sam+bho ga u pa da sha ka kle she ga ra pra sha ma ka shu n+ya tā swā bha wa a nu swa ri ma hā bo dhi sa twa ba ra ba ra ta ba ra ṇa da na/

oṃ ma hā pā sha pra sa ra a sa ma sa ma/ a nan+ta sa ma sa man+ta bha tra sa man+ta san+ta ra sa man+ta a ka ra sa man+ta pra sa ra sa ra sa ra he he mañdzu ra ba ma hā badz+ra ma hā kha ḍa kha/ tshin+dha tshin+dha/ bhin+dha bhin+dha/ bi ra dza bi ra dza karma a ba ga ma ka ku ru ku ru/ dhu ru dhu ru/ su ru su ru/ mu ru mu ru/ dha dha dha dha/ dhu dhu dhu dhu/ ma hā ma hā ma hā mo ha ya mo ha ya bho bho bhi ma bhi ma na da na da sa ra sa ra ma hā bodhi satwa mo tsa ya mo ma nā thā ma ma nu pri ta a pa ya du khan su ka da ma hā ru ṇi ka a nā tho han duḥkhi to han sa ra dzo han u pad dru to nan/ a bi bika te han ku si dho han mā ra ṇa dharmo han twa na bha ga bān duḥ khi tā nāṃ su kan da da a nā thā nāṃ pa nā tha ka sa ra dza sa ma bi ra dza ska ra u pa dā drud tā māṃ sa ra u pa dra ba pra sha ma ka a bi big tā ni ku sha la sam+bha ra pa ri pū ra yi ta ku pa dā nā ma hā bīt+ya dha tā ma rā ṇa dharmī ṇi ma mi ta bo dā dā dā ma ma bi bha ga wān nā tho bha ba sha rā ṇaṃ pa ra yā nāṃ trā tā/ sarba duḥkha ni me pra sha ma ya sarba kle sha ra dzi si mi a ba na ya sarba san pa ra u pa dra ba duḥ kha ni me nā sha ya sar+b+ba ku sha la dhar+m+ma pa ri pū ra me ku ru sar+b+ba kar+m+ma ā ba ra ṇa kle sha sarba ta me bi ka ri ma hā bodhi satwa si bi dhi bīt+ya pā ra mi tā yo gaṃ me pan+ni yo dza ya a ra ṇa dharma bi ra ka bi ra dza pan dza ha pra dza ha dha ra ṇi pa ṣa sa ma dza la ni dha sa ma me tu sa ma ma hā bo dhi satwa ba ra da swāhā/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga ba te/ dhar+m+ma dhā tu ni gardzi ta rā dza ya ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyaka saṃ bu d+dha ya/ na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ ku ma ra bhu tā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ dz+nya na lo ke/ tri rat+na baṃ sha saṃ dha ra ṇi/ bha ga wa ti/ a bā yaṃ dhā ḍhi/ a bā yam rte me bo dhi tsit+ta badz+ra pa ri ba lā ya/ sa man+tā a ba bhā sem ha na ha na/

sar+b+ba satwa saṃ ta na pa ri taṃ/ kle shā nu ts+tshe dā ya/ ba ra lak+ṣa ṇa a lam kṛ ta sha rī re/ bo dhi sa twa shi shum ba ti pū lā ya/ bud dha na de shā yā/ de ba/ nā ga yak+ṣa/ gaṃ dharba/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ ki na ra/ ma ho ra ga ba she s+d+yā ba ya/ a ba yaṃ da da ti swāhā/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ bo dhi satwā ya/ oṃ mañdzu ba ra/ mañdzu gho ṣa/ ha na ha na/ pa tsa pa tsa/ ma ta ma ta/ ma tha ma tha/ bi dh+waṃ sa ya bi dh+waṃ sa ya/ ka ra ka ra/ tru ṭa tru ṭa/ bhaṃ dza bhaṃ dza/ a bhi sa a bhi sa/ tu ṭa tu ṭa/ tru ṭa tru ṭa/ s+phu ṭa s+phu ṭa/ hri da ya baṃ dha ni/ na maḥ sam bo dha ni/ pra bo sha pra bo sha lo ta lo ta/ kṛ ta kṛ ta/ kṛ da kṛ da kṛ da kṛ da kṛ da kṛ da/ ha sa ha sa/ pra bhan+dha pra bhan+dha/ ā bi sha ā bi sha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ ku mā ra bhu tā ya/ bo dhi satwa ya ma hā sa twa ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a ra dze/ bi ra dze/ shūd+dhe/ bi shūd+dhe/ sho dha ni bi shod+dha ni/ a ma le/ bi ma le/ dza ya ba hi ni/ ru ru tsa le hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ ye dharmā he tu pra bhā wa he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga te h+ya wa tad/ te ṣañtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā di ma hā shra ma ṇa/ shes bya'i mkha' dbyings zab cing yangs pa la/ /blo gros dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /skye dgu'i mi shes mun pa'i tshogs rnams kun/ /sel byed dbang po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud/ /deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar/ /khyod min bde skyid bu 'khrid skyabs ma mchis/ /las kyi dbang gis rigs drug gar skyes kyang / /'khor ba'i 'jigs las skyobs shig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /bde skyid bu 'khrid dus las yol ba na/ /brtse zhing byams pa'i gnyen bshes kun dang bral/ /rngam zhing 'jigs pa'i gshin rjes zin pa'i tshe/ /gshin rje'i 'jigs las skyobs shig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/

/thog med dus nas las ngan bsags pa'i mthus/ /srid pa bar dor nyon mongs rlung shugs kyis/ /bzod dka'i ngan 'gro'i g.yang sar 'khyer srid pas/ /nyon mongs rlung sgo chod cig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /bar do'i rnam shes nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe/ /mi khom brgyad po dag las rab 'das shing / /thub bstan rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i rigs dag tu/ /skye ba'i rten 'brel sgrigs shig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /skye ba phyi mar mtho ris yon tan mchog /bdun gyis mdzes pa'i dal 'byor lus thob nas/ /bstan pa tshul bzhin 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen dang / /mjal ba'i rten 'brel sgrigs shig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje ldan pa'i bshes gnyen des/ /legs par gsungs pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /tshul bzhin rtogs nas gzhan la ston nus pa'i/ /rnam dpyod blo gros stsol cig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /tshe rabs kun tu gzhan don kho na'i phyir/ /ser sna med par bdog pa kun gtong zhing / /rnam g.yengs spangs ba'i bsam gtan sgom pa sogs/ /phar phyin drug ldan stsol cig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /'khor ba'i tsha gdung sel ba'i bsil byed mchog /gsung rab gangs ri'i ngos la blta 'dod kyang / /rnam g.yengs le lo'i 'dam du byings lags pas/ /myur mgyogs thugs rjes zungs shig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /zab lam lta ba'i lam du rab zhugs nas/ /rnam grol thar pa'i gling du 'gro 'dod kyang / /bde skyid bu 'khrid 'khor ba'i zhags pas bcing / /'khor ba'i zhen thag chod cig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /rang don nyer zhi kun da'i tshal spangs nas/ /rlabs chen rgyal ba'i pad tshal blta 'dod kyang / /bde skyid bu 'khrid ma rig mun pas bsgribs/ /ma rig 'thibs po sol zhig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /mdor na bde skyid bu 'khrid skye kun tu/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bsten byed cing / /'gro la 'dod dgu ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid bzhin nor bur gyur cig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/

/'jam dbyangs khyed la gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /tshogs gnyis rnam par dag pa'i gru chen gyi/ /'gro rnams 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol ba la/ /bde skyid bu 'khrid khyod gyur 'jam pa'i dbyangs// ༈ /phyag rdor thugs kar/ tad+ya thā bha bho san+nā ga a dhi pa te/ i daṃ ni lāṃ ba ra dha ra sha rī raṃ/ badz+ra pā ṇi hri da yaṃ/ yaḥ sa mā ti kra ma tha/ mā ku lota sā da na bha bi ṣ+ya ti/ tad+ya thā/ bud+dha bud+dha/ bi bud+dha mā ti kra ma tha ha ra ha ra nā gā nāṃ/ pra ha ra pra ha ra nā gā nāṃ/ ts+tshan+da ts+tshan+da nā gā hri da yā ni/ bhin+dha bin+dha nā gā marmā ṇi/ bi shī d+yaṃ tu nā ga sha rī rā ṇi/ bi s+pho ṭa ya nā ga na ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ tad+ya thā/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nā ga bi dā ra ṇā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ nā ge ta sā da nā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ nī la ba sa nāṃ ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ a pra ta ha ta ba la sa ra kra mā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ kṛ tan tā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ kṛ tān ta ru pā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ro ṣa ṇā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ trā pa nā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ku smāṃ ḍe ta pā da nā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ pre ta si shā tsa bi nā sha kā ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ yak+ṣa a pa smā ra bi nā sha ka rā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ha sa ha sa/ dha ra dha ra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ sar+b+ba bigh+nanaṃ bi nā sha ka rā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba shā truṃ saṃ gha bi nā sha ka ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ nī lāṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi rā dz+nyā pa ya ti swāhā/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he dun+te ṣan+ta thā ga to h+ya wa tad/ te ṣañtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ stobs po che la drag shul che/ /rigs sngags rgyal po dge ba sogs/ /gdul dka' ma lus 'dul mdzad pa/ /rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skal bzang bde skyid bu 'khrid sogs/ /bdag la 'brel thogs thams cad kyis/ /tshe rabs du mar bsags pa yi/ /sdig ltung nyes kun sbyang du gsol/ /de dag 'chi 'pho'i sems can rnams/ /mnar gcod sdug bsngal med par shog /srid pa bar do'i sems can rnams/

/'jigs med rang dbang thob par shog /'jig rten khams na dmyal ba dag /gang dag ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /de dag tu ni lus can rnams/ /bde chen bde bas dga' bar shog /grang bas nyam thag drod thob shog /byang chub sems dpa'i sprin chen las/ /byung ba'i chu bo mtha' yas kyis/ /tsha bas nyam thag bsil bar shog /dud 'gro rnams ni gcig la gcig /za ba'i 'jigs pa bral bar shog /sgra mi snyan pa'i mi bzhin du/ /yi dwags rnams ni bde bar gyur/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /phyag nas 'bab pa'i 'o rgyun gyis/ /yi dwags rnams ni tshim byas shing / /khrus byas rtag tu bsil bar shog /lha dang lha min mi yul gyi/ /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /rtag tu dal 'byor lus thob nas/ /dge ba'i bshes dang mjal bar shog /byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing / /thos bsam bsgom la brtson par shog /tshe ring nad med 'byor ldan zhing / /bstan 'gror phan bde'i byed por shog /lung rtogs yon tan mthar phyin pa'i/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su kun gyur cig/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rten thams cad kyi gnas gsum du/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
